definitions.explanation: The vertical distance from the surface of a body of water to its bottom. Used in geography, navigation, diving, and pool measurements.

examples.japanese: このプールの{水深|すいしん}は1.2メートルだ。
examples.english: The depth of this pool is 1.2 meters.

examples.japanese: {水深|すいしん}200メートルを{超|こ}えると、{太陽|たいよう}の{光|ひかり}はほとんど{届|とど}かなくなる。
examples.english: Beyond a depth of 200 meters, sunlight barely reaches.

notes: Common collocations: {水深|すいしん}〜メートル (depth of ~ meters), {水深|すいしん}が{深|ふか}い/{浅|あさ}い (deep/shallow water depth), {最大|さいだい}{水深|すいしん} (maximum depth). Used in maritime navigation, scuba diving, fishing, and pool safety signs. Related: {深|ふか}さ (depth — general), {海底|かいてい} (sea floor), {深海|しんかい} (deep sea).
